description: Fleet dashboard for one or more sp-rtk-base base stations. The Fleet overview at the top has one row per base, worst Base health first, and ignores the Base selector. Fleet trends compares the selected bases; below it, one section per selected base. Pick a Prometheus datasource; the scrape job must be named sp-rtk-base and carry a base label.

panels.description: One row per base, whatever the Base selector says, worst Base health first. Base health and every threshold: see docs/monitoring/README.md, Base health. Anchored on Prometheus's scrape status for the sp-rtk-base job, so a base it can't scrape stays as Down. Click a base to select it.

targets.expr:
max by (base) (
    label_replace(3 * (up{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 0), "check", "down", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (sp_rtk_base_relay_running{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 0), "check", "relay", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (sp_rtk_base_input_connected{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 0), "check", "input", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (sp_rtk_base_input_seconds_since_last_data{job="sp-rtk-base"} > bool 60), "check", "rtcm", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_signal_quality{job="sp-rtk-base"} >= bool 1, "check", "signal_quality", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_active_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"} < bool sp_rtk_base_total_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"}, "check", "destinations", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_bluetooth_link_strength{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 2, "check", "bluetooth", "", "")
  or label_replace((sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 2) * on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == bool 1), "check", "wifi_uplink", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_host_cpu_temperature_celsius{job="sp-rtk-base"} >= bool 80, "check", "cpu_temperature", "", "")
  or label_replace(increase(sp_rtk_base_host_undervoltage_events_total{job="sp-rtk-base"}[1h]) > bool 0, "check", "undervoltage", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_host_memory_available_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} / sp_rtk_base_host_memory_total_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} < bool 0.1, "check", "memory", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_host_root_filesystem_available_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} / sp_rtk_base_host_root_filesystem_size_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} < bool 0.1, "check", "root_filesystem", "", "")
)

max by (base, destinations) (
  label_join(
      count_values by (base) ("active", sp_rtk_base_active_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"})
    * on (base) group_left (total)
      count_values by (base) ("total", sp_rtk_base_total_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"}),
    "destinations", "/", "active", "total"
  )
)

max by (base, uplink) (
    label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="ethernet"} == 1, "uplink", "Ethernet", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == 1, "uplink", "Wi-Fi", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_uplink_other{job="sp-rtk-base"} == 1, "uplink", "Other", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_uplink_other{job="sp-rtk-base"} != sp_rtk_base_network_uplink_other{job="sp-rtk-base"}, "uplink", "No reading", "", "")
)

max by (base, wifi) (topk by (base) (1, max by (base, interface, wifi) (
    label_join(
        label_join(
            count_values without () ("dbm", sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"} == sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"})
          * on (base, interface) group_left (band) sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_band{job="sp-rtk-base"},
          "wifi", " dBm · ", "dbm", "band"
        )
      * on (base, interface) group_left (role) (
            label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == 0, "role", " · not Uplink", "", "")
          or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} != 0, "role", "", "", "")
        ),
      "wifi", "", "wifi", "role"
    )
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == 0, "wifi", "Disconnected", "", "")
  or label_replace((sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} != 0) unless on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_band{job="sp-rtk-base"} and on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"} == sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"})), "wifi", "No reading", "", "")
)))

panels.title: Fleet overview

panels.description: The selected bases whose Uplink is Wi-Fi, one colour per base. A base on an Ethernet Uplink isn't drawn: its radio doesn't count against Base health. The red line is Poor (≤ -78 dBm).

targets.expr:
max by (base) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"}
  * on (base, interface) group_left () (sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} == 1))

panels.description: CPU temperature of the selected bases, one colour per base. The red line is 80 °C, where a Pi throttles and Base health turns Degraded.
panels.title: CPU temperature

panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle or waiting on I/O, over all cores, one colour per base.

         / sum by (base) (rate(sp_rtk_base_host_cpu_seconds_total{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Base health

panels.description: Whether the Relay is running (stopped, even deliberately, is a Fault), and how long it has run.
panels.title: Relay

panels.description: Whether the Input is connected, and its kind (from sp_rtk_base_input_info; just "Input" on an older base).
panels.title: Input

panels.description: Seconds since the Input last delivered RTCM. Over 60 s is a Fault.
panels.title: Last RTCM

panels.description: How well the antenna hears the satellites, as the base's own dashboard shows it. No reading while no MSM is arriving.
panels.title: Signal Quality

panels.description: How well the base hears its Bluetooth module. n/a (not a fault) when the Input isn't Bluetooth.

targets.expr:
label_replace(max by (base) (sp_rtk_base_bluetooth_link_strength{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"} unless on (base) sp_rtk_base_input_info{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind!="bluetooth"}), "kind", "Bluetooth Input", "", "")
  or label_replace(max by (base, kind) (-1 * sp_rtk_base_input_info{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind!="bluetooth"}), "kind", "Input is $1", "kind", "(.+)")

panels.title: Bluetooth link strength

panels.description: The latest Wi-Fi link strength in dBm, its Wi-Fi link band, and whether the link is the Uplink. — means no Wi-Fi interface. Disconnected (greyed) behind an Ethernet Uplink isn't counted against Base health.

targets.expr:
max by (base, interface, band, role) (
    (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"} == sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"}) * on (base, interface) group_left (band) sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_band{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"}
  + on (base, interface) group_left (role) (0 * (
        label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} == 1, "role", " · the Uplink", "", "")
     or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} == 0, "role", " · not Uplink", "", "")
     or (sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} != sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"})
  ))
  or label_replace(0 * sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} + 1, "role", " · not in use", "", "") and on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} == 0)
  or label_replace(0 * sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} + 2, "role", "", "", "") and on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base", kind="wifi"} != 0)
     unless on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_band{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"} and on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"} == sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base", base=~"$base"}))
)
